description: Admissions are split at random rather than by patient, so the same patient appears in train and test. Reported performance is inflated.
Minimum SpO2 is taken over the whole stay, including values recorded after the prediction time. The model sees the future.
The median imputer is fitted on all admissions before the split. Test-set statistics enter training.
Inference reorders the feature columns alphabetically and passes a bare array, so features reach the model in the wrong positions. Served scores differ from validated scores.
metrics.json is computed on all admissions, training rows included, not on the test predictions it sits beside. The reported AUROC cannot be reproduced from test_predictions.csv.
If validation fails at inference the table is re-read without validation. Out-of-range or wrong-unit inputs are scored silently.
Non-numeric values are coerced to missing instead of rejected. Corrupt inputs are imputed silently.
The gradient boosting model samples features without a random_state. Two runs give different models and metrics.
Lab feature order comes from a set, which depends on the string hash seed. Column order can differ between processes.
pandas is range-pinned and scikit-learn is unpinned. Rebuilds can pick up different library versions.
yaml is imported but PyYAML is not in requirements.txt. A clean install fails at run time.
The non-numeric input test is skipped, hiding the coercion defect.
The metrics test prints instead of asserting. It cannot fail.
The code reads model.threshold but the config defines model.alert_threshold, so a 0.5 default is used silently instead of the configured 0.30.
A recalibration step exists but is never called by the pipeline. Scores are uncalibrated despite the code suggesting otherwise.
